draft.details:
On 2026-09-12, I fell on my outstretched right hand at the Emergency Department, Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast. I was X-rayed and told there was no fracture, just a sprain, and I was sent home with no follow-up. The pain continued. On 2026-10-09, another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job.

My complaint to Belfast Health and Social Care Trust: I sent a complaint to Belfast Health and Social Care Trust explaining that I fell on my outstretched right hand, was X-rayed and told there was no fracture, just a sprain, and sent home with no follow-up. The pain continued. On 2026-10-09, another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job. I asked for an explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation.

What Belfast Health and Social Care Trust said: Belfast Health and Social Care Trust wrote that the wrist was examined and X-rayed in line with its procedures, the X-ray was reported as showing no fracture at the time, and it apologised that I had a poor experience. It did not explain why no follow-up was arranged.

Why this is not resolved: I am still unhappy because the Trust did not explain why no follow-up was arranged or why no MRI or follow-up X-ray was done.

Dear Northern Ireland Public Services Ombudsman (NIPSO),

I would like you to look at my complaint about Belfast Health and Social Care Trust.

On 2026-09-12, I fell on my outstretched right hand at the Emergency Department, Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast. I was X-rayed and told there was no fracture, just a sprain, and I was sent home with no follow-up. The pain continued. On 2026-10-09, another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job.

My complaint to Belfast Health and Social Care Trust: I sent a complaint to Belfast Health and Social Care Trust explaining that I fell on my outstretched right hand, was X-rayed and told there was no fracture, just a sprain, and sent home with no follow-up. The pain continued. On 2026-10-09, another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job. I asked for an explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation.

What Belfast Health and Social Care Trust said: Belfast Health and Social Care Trust wrote that the wrist was examined and X-rayed in line with its procedures, the X-ray was reported as showing no fracture at the time, and it apologised that I had a poor experience. It did not explain why no follow-up was arranged.

Why this is not resolved: I am still unhappy because the Trust did not explain why no follow-up was arranged or why no MRI or follow-up X-ray was done.

What I would like: An explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation.
